legacy_breakpoints: 767px split and mobile-only/desktop-only duplicate trees — discarded

P1.mobile: stacked: threshold → specimen → sheet → six steps (vertical) → ledger (stacked, YOU/AIO tags) → sealed specimen → terms → start; sticky REQUEST FILING
P1.tablet: two-column threshold; sheet in two columns
P1.desktop: threshold 7/5 with specimen; sheet three columns; horizontal six-step rail; two-sided ledger

mobile.task_model: capture-first task flow: snap receipts at the pump, resolve one flag at a time, approve in one decision window
mobile.layout: quarter header (state · % · due) → single next action → compartments as collapsible rows → sticky TAKE PHOTO / CONTINUE
mobile.primary_object_treatment: quarter card pinned at top with a completeness ring
mobile.input_treatment: camera + upload as full-width primary; mileage source picker as a sheet

tablet.task_model: review-and-resolve: compartments side by side, flags resolved in place
tablet.layout: quarter header + two-column compartments (receipts | mileage) with vehicles strip
tablet.primary_object_treatment: quarter header with timeline of the six steps

desktop.task_model: workbench: build and check the packet with everything visible
desktop.layout: left: quarter + six-step progress; centre: active compartment (receipt grid / mileage table by state × truck); right: flags + messages
desktop.primary_object_treatment: quarter as the bench object with compartments as tabs of one packet
desktop.input_treatment: bulk upload, ELD report upload, spreadsheet mapping

C2.mobile: slips as two-line cards, flagged first, class chips scroll horizontally
C2.tablet: ledger with 5 columns (truck folds into line 2)
C2.desktop: full 7-column slip ledger + capture bar + totals

C3.mobile: one lane per truck, collapsible; source picker as a bottom sheet
C3.tablet: lanes side by side with receipts

C6.mobile: sheet full width, decision bar sticky at bottom

S1.mobile: grouped by bucket, one next action per row

S2.mobile: next action → blockers → status list → actions; tables 'best on desktop'

rules: Mobile never shrinks the staff desktop (sprint §20)
Desktop supports operational review: workbench, multi-zone review, receipt queue, mileage table, status rail, filing sidebar (sprint §21)
Sticky task bar on client mobile: TAKE PHOTO + the state's one CTA
